tunnel.title: Saitunan Sadarwa
tunnel.liveP2pDesc: P2P Kai-tsaye da Cloudflare Anycast TURN na aiki. Yana fara haƙon ramin STUN NAT kai-tsaye tsakanin wuraren amintaccen kayan aiki tare da zaɓin komawa zuwa Anycast TURN relay ta atomatik a kan hanyoyin sadarwa na salula masu daidaito.
tunnel.liveCloudDesc: An fara wakilin Cloud TLS Proxy. Ana tursasa zirga-zirgar kira ta Port 443 TCP/UDP. Ana ɓoye fakitin bayanai a matsayin zirga-zirgar HTTPS ta TLS 1.3 ta al'ada tare da rage hayaniyar kayan aiki ta Agora SD-RTN.
tunnel.liveStealthDesc: Stealth HTTP/3 na aiki. An kunna QUIC ta asali ta dandamali daban-daban, DoQ/DoH na warwarewa tare da IP Pinning kai-tsaye, relay na Vercel Edge mara sabar yana a shirye, an kunna tace kura ta gefe, kuma tsarin CBR na matakai 2 yana ɓoye firam ɗin midiya a matsayin bayanan yanar gizo marasa illa.
tunnel.diagThrottling: BINCIKE: AN GANO TACEWA KO RAGE GUDU ({latency}ms)
tunnel.p2pBullet1Desc: Yana gano adresoshin cibiyar sadarwa na jama'a ta amfani da musayar STUN marar uwar garke ta tsakiya.
tunnel.p2pBullet2Desc: Yana haɗa na'urorin abokan sadarwa kai tsaye ba tare da wata uwar garke ta tsakiya da ke taɓa fakitin sauti ko bidiyo ba.
tunnel.p2pBullet3Title: Tabbatar da Maɓalli Daga Farko Zuwa Ƙarshe:
tunnel.p2pBullet3Desc: Yana tabbatar da sirrin gaba (forward secrecy) tare da maɓallan wucin gadi da ake tattaunawa a kan na'urar kawai.
tunnel.cloudBullet1Desc: Yana amfani da mabanbantan wuraren sadarwa na duniya domin samun haɗin sadarwa mai saurin gaske da ƙarancin jinkiri.
tunnel.cloudBullet2Desc: Yana haɗa fakitin kira cikin kwararar bayanan burawzar yanar gizo marasa illa.
tunnel.cloudBullet3Desc: Yana shawo kan katangar tsaro (firewalls) mai daidaito nan take, yana adana baturi da ƙarfin sarrafa na'ura.
tunnel.stealthBullet1Title: HTTP/3 na Asali a Dukkan Manhajoji:
tunnel.stealthBullet1Desc: Yana tura zaman kira ta hanyar Chromium Cronet (Android) da URLSession HTTP/3 na asali (iOS) tare da sauya haɗin 0-RTT UDP 443.
tunnel.stealthBullet2Title: DoQ (DNS ta kan QUIC) da DoH:
tunnel.stealthBullet2Desc: Yana warware sunayen yankuna ta hanyar QUIC mai rufin asiri (tasha 853) da masu warwarewa na HTTPS Anycast ba tare da barin sawu a kan diski ba.
tunnel.stealthBullet3Title: Tsayar da IP na DoH/DoQ (IP Pinning):
tunnel.stealthBullet3Desc: Yana haɗa adresoshin IP da aka warware kai tsaye zuwa jigilar soket na asali yayin kiyaye daidaitattun kanun TLS SNI Host.
tunnel.stealthBullet4Title: Relay na Uwar-garke Mara Sabar (Edge Relay):
tunnel.stealthBullet4Desc: Wakilin siginar HTTP/3 na ɓoye da aka tura a Vercel Edge tare da Upstash KV da adana bayanai na sauri a ƙwaƙwalwa.
tunnel.stealthBullet5Title: Tace Amon Bogi a Gefen Cibiyar Sadarwa:
tunnel.stealthBullet5Desc: Yana fitar da fakitin amo na bogi waɗanda ake amsawa da 200 OK a gefen cibiyar sadarwa kuma a cire su kafin isarwa ga abokin sadarwa don adana bayanan na'urar.
tunnel.stealthBullet6Title: Daidaita Girman Fakiti na CBR Mai Matakai 2:
tunnel.stealthBullet6Desc: Yana tilasta cika fakiti daidai gwargwadon baiti a cikin girman 512B, 1024B, 1536B, da 2048B don karya binciken DPI mai dogaro da tsawon fakiti.
tunnel.techSpecTransportDesc: Ana rufe zaman sigina a cikin DTLS (Datagram Transport Layer Security) mai darajar soja tare da cikakken sirrin gaba. Ba a ajiye kowane tarihi a tsakiya, kuma maɓallan wucin gadi da aka musaya tsakanin abokan sadarwa ne kawai za su iya buɗe rafin sauti mai aiki.
tunnel.techSpecCollateralDesc: Yanayin Cloud TLS da Stealth suna amfani da alamun fakitin TLS na yau da kullun don kwaikwayon zirga-zirgar yanar gizo marar illa. Wannan yana tilasta wa shingen tacewa zaɓi tsakanin barin zaman kiran ya wuce ko kuma katse miliyoyin hanyoyin kasuwanci na yanar gizo a kan cibiyoyin sadarwarsu.
tunnel.techSpecNatDesc: A ƙarƙashin matsanancin NAT mai tsauri (kamar tsarin cibiyoyin sadarwar wayar hannu masu sarkakiya), haɗin kai tsaye yana komawa kan hanyar madadin cikin sauƙi, yana kiyaye ingancin maɓalli, ɓoyewar metadata, da sirrin sauti marar lahani.
tunnel.activeProtocols: TSARUKAN SADARWA MASU AIKI DA KWAREWARSU
tunnel.p2pFeat1Desc: Yana kafa haɗin abokan sadarwa kai tsaye ta amfani da STUN ba tare da uwar garke ta tsakiya ba.
tunnel.p2pFeat2Title: 2. Aika Bayanai ta Cloudflare Anycast TURN
tunnel.p2pFeat2Desc: Komawa kan Anycast TURN ba tare da yankewa ba a kan cibiyoyin sadarwar wayar hannu masu tsauri.
tunnel.p2pFeat3Desc: Yana adana caji kuma yana inganta ingancin murya ta hanyar guje wa zagaye marar amfani.
tunnel.cloudFeat1Desc: Yana sanya siginar sarrafa kira a cikin amintaccen zirga-zirgar yanar gizo na SSL.
tunnel.cloudFeat2Desc: Yana canza kamannin farkon zama domin tsallake matatun ƙa'idojin hanyar sadarwa.
tunnel.cloudFeat3Title: 3. Wakilin Cloud Proxy na Agora SD-RTN
tunnel.cloudFeat3Desc: Yana riƙe sadarwar murya tare da fasahar AI ta rage hayaniya a kayan aiki.
tunnel.stealthFeat1Title: 1. HTTP/3 da QUIC na Asali a Dukkan Manhajoji
tunnel.stealthFeat1Desc: Yana aika siginar kira ta hanyar injunan Chromium Cronet (Android) da URLSession HTTP/3 (iOS 15+) na asali tare da sauya haɗin 0-RTT.
tunnel.stealthFeat2Title: 2. Mai Warware DNS na DoQ da DoH Mai Rufin Asiri
tunnel.stealthFeat2Desc: Yana bincika DNS ta kan QUIC (tasha 853) tare da madadin DoH zuwa AdGuard/Cloudflare/Quad9, yana kauce wa jirkita DNS na kamfanonin sadarwa gaba ɗaya.
tunnel.stealthFeat3Title: 3. DoH/DoQ IP Pinning da Kiyaye SNI
tunnel.stealthFeat3Desc: Yana haɗa IP da aka warware kai tsaye zuwa jigilar QUIC/soket yayin kiyaye kanun Host masu bin ka'idar RFC don karya leƙen asirin DNS.
tunnel.stealthFeat4Title: 4. Relay na Edge Mara Sabar & Steganography
tunnel.stealthFeat4Desc: Wakilin siginar ɓoye na ƙasa da 100ms a kan Vercel Edge tare da Upstash KV & adana bayanai na sauri a ƙwaƙwalwa.
tunnel.stealthFeat5Title: 5. Matatar Amon Bogi da Zirga-zirgar Yaudarawa
tunnel.stealthFeat5Desc: Yana aika fakitin amo na Poisson masu rikitarwa waɗanda ake amsawa da 200 OK a gefen cibiyar sadarwa kuma a cire su kafin isarwa ga abokin sadarwa, yana kawar da alamun shiru.
tunnel.stealthFeat6Title: 6. Daidaita Girman Fakiti na CBR Mai Matakai 2
tunnel.stealthFeat6Desc: Yana daidaita girman fakiti daidai da baiti zuwa 512B, 1024B, 1536B, ko 2048B don karya ci-gaban binciken ƙididdiga da tsawon fakiti na DPI.

info.title: Bayani
info.guideSubtitle: Wannan jagorar tana bayyana yadda manhajar inWhite ke aiki, ka'idojin tsaro, da jerin siffofinta. Bi waɗannan umarnin mataki-mataki don saita amintacciyar cibiyar sadarwarka.
info.guideStep1Text: inWhite ba ya amfani da rumbun adana bayanai na tsakiya, lambobin waya, imel, ko bayanan bibiyar kai.
info.guideStep1WhiteIdDesc: Da zaran an buɗe manhajar, ana ƙirƙirar maɓallan sirri na fili da na ɓoye amintattu (Curve25519) a cikin amintaccen ɓangaren kayan aikin na'urarka. Shaidarka tana bayyana ne kawai a matsayin lambar shaida ta musamman da aka rarraba (whiteID misali: blind_124495...).
info.guideStep1LockDesc: Taɓa "Yi Rijista" yana kulle waɗannan bayanan shaidar dindindin a ma'ajiyar na'urarka ta gida ta amfani da tsarin Keystore ko Keychain na kayan aiki. Babu wata hanyar dawo da kalmar sirri daga nesa; shaidarka ta na'urarka ce kawai.
info.guideStep2Text: Ƙara abokan hulɗa ido-da-ido ko ta hanyoyin sadarwa amintattu ba tare da bayyana mahimman bayanan ciki (metadata) ba.
info.guideStep2ExchangeDesc: Je zuwa allon Lambobin Sadarwa, taɓa gunkin duba lambar a saman dama ko allon Ƙara Mutum, sannan yi amfani da kyamarar na'urarka domin duba lambar QR mai canzawa ta abokin hulɗarka. Wannan yana musayar shaidar maɓallin sirri na fili nan take ta iska.
info.guideStep2DirectoryDesc: Littafin adireshinka yana nan ne kawai a cikin rumbun adana bayanai da aka rufe da sirrin AES-256-GCM a na'urarka. Manhajar ba ta taɓa bincikar kundayen adireshi na tsakiya ba.
info.guideStep2StealthDesc: Domin kiyaye sirri sosai, kunna "Ɓoye lambobin sadarwa daga babban allo" a ƙarƙashin Saitunan Kira. Lambobin sadarwa za su bayyana nan take ne kawai idan an bincika su.
info.guideStep3Text: Dukkan kwararar kiran sauti na gudana ne ta ramukan sadarwa da aka rarraba ta amfani da injina masu ƙarancin jinkiri.
info.guideStep3PerfDesc: Tare da goyon bayan tsarin C++ WebRTC da Agora, inWhite yana isar da siginar murya mai ingancin CD na 48kHz.
info.guideStep3DspTitle: Tace Sauti ta Kayan Aikin DSP:
info.guideStep3DspDesc: Yana amfani da AEC ta asali (Kawar da Amsa-kuwwa), AI ANC (Kawar da Hayaniya) domin cire hayaniyar ababen hawa/iska, da AGC (Daidaita Ƙarfin Sauti ta Atomatik) domin daidaita matakan ɗaukar sauti.
info.guideStep3FallbackDesc: Haɗin kira yana lura da asarar fakitin bayanai a kowane lokaci. Idan aka gano cikas daga hanyar sadarwa/ISP, ƙofar sauti tana kunna sauya mashiga ta gaggawa da kuma tsara kwararar bayanai.
info.guideStep4Text: Aika gajerun saƙonni masu ɓacewa, fayiloli, da lambobin hash na sirri cikin aminci.
info.guideStep4E2eeDesc: Ana rufe abin da ke cikin saƙo a na'urar mai aikawa kafin a tura shi, kuma maɓallin sirri na mai karɓa kaɗai zai iya buɗe shi.
info.guideStep4RatchetDesc: Domin matuƙar tsaron sirri, ramukan sadarwa suna canza bayanan kan saƙo a kowane aiki, ba tare da barin wata alama ga masu leƙen asiri na kamfanoni ko gwamnati ba.
info.guideStep5Title: 5. Akwatin Saƙo Mai Cin Gashin Kansa (WhiteMail)
info.guideStep5Text: Sadarwa marar metadata wacce ke aiki da fasahar ɓoyewa ta maɓallin jama'a tsakanin na'urori, ba tare da uwar garken SMTP/IMAP ta tsakiya ba:
info.guideStep5E2eeDesc: Dukkan jigo, saƙon ciki, da maƙalan fayiloli ana rufe su da sirri a na'urar mai amfani ta amfani da maɓallin fili na mai karɓa (Blind ID).
info.guideStep5FoldersTitle: Jakunkuna da Ma'ajiyar Tarihi Masu Cin Gashin Kansu:
info.guideStep5FoldersDesc: Sarrafa sadarwarka a cikin Akwatin Shigowa, Akwatin Fita, Waɗanda Aka Aika, Waɗanda Aka Goge, da Ma'ajiya tare da bincike na nan take a cikin na'ura ba tare da intanet ba.
info.guideStep5PairingTitle: Haɗa Abokan Sadarwa Ba Tare da Saƙonnin Banza Ba:
info.guideStep5PairingDesc: Masu aikawa da ba a sani ba dole ne su gabatar da buƙatar haɗin kai ta sirri kafin isar da saƙonni, wanda ke kawar da saƙonnin banza (spam) tun daga tushe.
info.guideStep6Title: 6. Teburin Tallafi Mai Cin Gashin Kansa (Tallafin WhiteDesk)
info.guideStep6Text: Tallafin injiniya kai tsaye da sarrafa tikitin tallafi tare da cikakken ɓoye suna da rashin buƙatar KYC:
info.guideStep6AnonymousDesc: Tikitin tallafi an jingina su ne kawai da lambar whiteID ta na'urarka. Ba a buƙatar ko riƙe adireshin imel, lambar waya, ko ainihin suna ko kaɗan.
info.guideStep6LifecycleDesc: Bibiya ci gaban tallafi ta hanyar yanayin A Buɗe, An Amsa, da A Rufe, kuma ka ci gaba da tattaunawa mai rufin asiri tare da kwararrun tallafi.
info.guideStep6MediaTitle: Fayilolin Binciken Matsala Masu Rufin Asiri:
info.guideStep6MediaDesc: Haɗa hotunan allo, hotunan kamara, da bayanan binciken matsala da aka ɓoye cikin aminci a kan na'ura don hanzarta warware matsala.
info.guideStep7Title: 7. Ramukan Yaki da Takunkumi Masu Matakai 3 & Lokacin Jira Mai Sauyawa
info.guideStep7Text: Daidaita ratsa hanyoyin sadarwa masu matakai daban-daban da iyakokin madadin aiki a allon Saitunan Ramin Sadarwa:
info.guideStep7P2pDesc: Kwararar midiya ta kai-tsaye tsakanin abokan hulɗa ta hanyar huda ramin STUN/ICE tare da Cloudflare TURN a matsayin madadin relay. Babu relays marasa amfani, ƙarancin jinkiri sosai.
info.guideStep7CloudDesc: Hanya mai juriya sosai a kan daidaitacciyar Port 443 ta HTTPS tare da rufin TLS 1.3, wadda ke kwaikwayon shiga yanar gizo amintacciya ta al'ada.
info.guideStep7StealthDesc: Steganography na HTTP/3 na ɓoye a wurare daban-daban tare da sauya mashiga da ɓoye fakiti domin tsallake shingen Binciken Fakiti Mai Zurfi (DPI).
info.guideStep7AdaptiveTitle: Lokacin Jira Mai Daidaitawa da Bincike:
info.guideStep7AdaptiveDesc: Binciken jinkiri na nan take yana daidaita lokacin sauya hanya (3.5s – 12.0s) ko kuma ya ba da damar sarrafawa da hannu, yana tabbatar da kiraye-kiraye marasa yankewa ko da a kan cibiyoyin sadarwa masu rauni.
info.manifestoMissionDesc: An ƙirƙiri inWhite tare da alƙawari ɗaya marar girgiza: dawo da 'yancin kai na dijital ta hanyar cikakken sirri. A cikin duniyar dijital da tattara bayanai a tsakiya ya mamaye, inWhite yana aiki a matsayin garkuwa marar tsakiya don sadarwa tsakanin mutane wacce ba a leƙen asirinta, amintacciya, kuma ta sirri.
info.manifestoPhilosophyP1Desc: Babu sawun bayanan kai. Ba a buƙatar lambobin waya, adireshin imel, ko asalin shaidar zamantakewa.
info.manifestoPhilosophyP2Desc: Masu amfani suna kasancewa a matsayin ɓangarori masu zaman kansu da ake gane su kawai ta hanyar whiteID da suka ƙirƙira kuma suka adana a na'urarsu. Babu wata hukuma ta tsakiya da ke riƙe da taswirar wanda ke magana da wani.
info.manifestoPhilosophyP3Desc: Dukkan zirga-zirga ana ɓoye su ta hanyar ramin TLS 443 da Agora Cloud Proxy, yana tabbatar da cewa sadarwa ta ci gaba ba tare da tsangwama ba kuma ba za a iya gano ta ba ko da a cikin hanyoyin sadarwa masu tsananin takunkumi.
info.manifestoSecurityP1Title: Shaidar da Ba a Sani Ba (whiteID):
info.manifestoSecurityP1Desc: Sadarwa tana farawa da maɓallai biyu marasa kama da na'ura ta samar. Shaidarka tabbaci ne na lissafi, ba fayil ɗin bayanan mutum ba.
info.manifestoSecurityP2Title: Sauti da Saƙo Masu Rufin Asiri Daga Farko Zuwa Ƙarshe (E2EE):
info.manifestoSecurityP2Desc: Duk bayanan murya da saƙonni ana ɓoye su ta amfani da maɓallan sirri na musamman ga na'urorin da ke sadarwa. Masu samar da ababen more rayuwa na waje ba sa ganin komai sai dai surutu marar ma'ana.
info.manifestoSecurityP3Desc: Cibiyar sadarwarka, jerin lambobin sadarwa, da tarihin saƙonninka ba a taɓa ajiye su a cikin uwar garke ta tsakiya ba. Suna zaune ne kawai a kan na'urarka, ana kare su da matakan ɓoyewa na cikin na'ura.
info.manifestoDataDesc1: Ana ajiye tarihin sadarwarka cikin aminci a kan na'urarka, a ɓoye yayin da yake ajiye. Ba ma ajiye saƙonninka, fayilolinka, ko jerin lambobin sadarwarka a kan kowace uwar garke ta tsakiya.
info.manifestoDataDesc2: Yayin da tattaunawarka ke ci gaba da kasancewa a kan na'urarka don sauƙin amfaninka, suna wanzuwa ne kawai a ƙarƙashin ikonka. Za ka iya share bayanan manhajarka a kowane lokaci, wanda zai cire duk bayanai daga na'urarka har abada ba tare da wata hanyar dawo da su daga nesa ba.
info.privacySubtitle: Sadarwarka ta sirri haƙƙin ɗan adam ne na asali. Tsarin fasaharmu marar bibiya yana ba da garantin cewa metadata da hanyoyin siginarka sun kasance a keɓe gaba ɗaya daga idon wasu.
info.qa1Question: Shin ana tattara wani bayani na kashin kai?
info.qa1Answer: A'a. inWhite yana bin tsauraran manufar Sifirin Bayanan Mutum. Ba a neman, ɗauka, ko ajiye lambobin waya, imel, sunaye, littafin lambobin sadarwa, ko wuraren GPS.
info.qa2Answer: Shaidarka tana da cikakken 'yancin kai da lissafi. Ana ƙirƙirar maɓallan sirri na fili da na ɓoye a na'urarka ta gida. whiteID ɗinka wakilcin hash ne na waɗannan maɓallan sirri ba tare da buƙatar intanet ba.
info.qa3Answer: Duk bayanai, gami da amintattun littattafan lambobin sadarwa, tarihin saƙonni, tarihin kira, da maɓallan saituna ana ajiye su a kan na'urarka a cikin ma'ajiyar bayanai masu rufin asiri da aka tsare da maɓallan na'ura (Keystore/Keychain).
info.qa4Question: Shin saƙonnina suna wanzuwa har abada?
info.qa4Answer: Tattaunawa na wucin gadi ne kuma a cikin na'ura kawai suke, yana tabbatar da cewa babu wata ma'ajiyar saƙonni ta tsakiya. Ana kare dukkan sadarwa ta hanyar ɓoyewar bayanai daga farko zuwa ƙarshe (E2EE) da ma'ajiyar cikin na'ura.
info.qa5Answer: Mun dauki alƙawarin cewa babu wani mai haɓaka manhaja, mai sayarwa, ko wakilin waje da zai iya shiga, ajiyewa, sake ginawa, ko bayyana sadarwar masu amfani. Duk nauyin sigina, tambarin lissafin sirri, da fakitin cibiyar sadarwa ana ɗaukar su a matsayin cikakken sirri kuma marasa sawu. Wannan ita ce yarjejeniyar sirrinmu mai ƙarfi da kai.
info.qa6Question: Shin inWhite Mail yana amfani da uwar garken SMTP/IMAP na gargajiya?
info.qa6Answer: A'a. inWhite Mail yana tsallake tsohon tsarin imel gaba ɗaya. Ana isar da saƙonni da maƙalansu kai-tsaye tsakanin WhiteIDs masu cin gashin kansu ta amfani da rufaffen sirri na asymmetric. Babu sabar imel ta waje, bayanan DNS, ko kan saƙo na metadata.
info.qa7Question: Ta yaya Teburin Tallafi ke kare shaidata?
info.qa7Answer: Tikitin tallafi an jingina su ne kawai da WhiteID ta na'urarka ta gida. Ba za a taɓa tambayarka adireshin imel, lambar waya, suna, ko bayanan biyan kuɗi ba domin samun cikakken tallafin fasaha.

admin_guide.title: Jagoran Mai Gudanarwa na WhiteDesk
admin_guide.subtitle: Na'urar Sarrafawa, Fasaloli & Littafin Ƙa'idoji
admin_guide.card1_title: 1. Kafa Mallaka & Rijistar Babban Mai Gudanarwa
admin_guide.card1_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Ana kunna shi yayin kafa farko ta hanyar rubuta "admin <enterprise_key>" a akwatin saƙon tikiti.
• Ƙa'idoji: Lambar maɓallin fili na kamfani da mai ba da lasisi ya bayar.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Da zaran an shigar da lambar, ana ƙirƙirar teburin rumbun adana bayanai na kamfani ta atomatik, ana yin rijistar maɓallin fili na na'urarka a matsayin Babban Mai Gudanarwa, kuma ana shigar da takardar shaidar maɓallin fili na ƙungiyar a na'urarka.
admin_guide.card2_title: 2. Tsarin Shaidar Ɓoye (Blind Identity) & Babu Bayanan Mutum
admin_guide.card2_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Menu mai ɗigo 3 > Teburin Bayanin Martaba.
• Ƙa'idoji: Lambar hash ta shaidar ɓoye ta hanya ɗaya da aka samo daga maɓallin tsaro na kalmomi 12 na kayan aiki.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Tsarin ba ya taɓa buƙatar lambobin waya, adiresoshin imel, ko ainihin sunaye daga masu amfani ko masu gudanarwa. Dukkan ayyuka suna gudana a kan shaidar ɓoye, yana kawar da haɗarin shari'a da riƙe bayanan mutum gaba ɗaya.
admin_guide.card3_title: 3. Ƙa'idar Rashin Ajiye Bayanai a Sabar
admin_guide.card3_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Fasahar tsari da matakin isar da tikiti (relay layer).
• Ƙa'idoji: Rukunin isar da saƙo na ɗan lokaci da manufofin ajiyar na'urar gida.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Yayin sadarwa, saƙonnin tikiti da maƙalansu ana riƙe su a rufe da sirri na ɗan lokaci kawai a gajimaren relay. Da zaran sun isa na'urar mai karɓa ko lokacin da aka rufe tikitin, bayanan gajimare na wucin gadi suna ƙafewa nan take dindindin; ana adana bayanai ne kawai a na'urorin gida na ɓangarorin.
admin_guide.card4_title: 4. Rukunin Tikiti & Alamar Gajimare Mai Ruwan Gwal
admin_guide.card4_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Babban jerin tikitin tallafi.
• Ƙa'idoji: Tikiti marasa lambar ID ta mai gudanarwa da aka sanya wa.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Sabbin tikitin da aka ƙirƙira waɗanda ba a ba kowa ba kuma ba a riga an karɓe su ta wani ƙwararren ba ana yi musu alama da gunkin gajimare mai ruwan gwal a katin tikiti. Lokacin da mai gudanarwa ya karɓi tikitin, gunkin gajimaren yana ɓacewa kuma ana sanya tikitin kai-tsaye ga wannan ƙwararren.
admin_guide.card5_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Menu mai ɗigo 3 a saman dama da shafin Saƙon Sirri (Whisper) a cikin cikakken bayanin tikiti.
• Ƙa'idoji: "Karɓi Tikiti", "Canza Sashe", "Miƙa Tikiti", "Rufe/Goge Tikiti".
• Dokoki:
  1. Tikiti da ke cikin rukunin gama-gari ko aka sanya wa wani mai gudanarwa suna nuna "Karɓi Tikiti" da "Canza Sashe" kawai; tikitin da ba a karɓa ba ba ya taɓa nuna "Miƙa Tikiti".
  2. Mai gudanarwa zai iya miƙawa ko goge tikitin da aka sanya masa da kansa kawai.
  3. Bayanan ciki na mai gudanarwa waɗanda mai amfani ba zai iya gani ba ana raba su a rufe da sirri ta shafin "Whisper".
admin_guide.card6_title: 6. Matsayin Aiki & Hanyar Tikiti Mai Hankali
admin_guide.card6_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Menu mai ɗigo 3 > "Matsayin Aiki".
• Ƙa'idoji: "A Shirye", "Ba Ya Aiki", "A Hutu".
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Tsarin ba ya sanya tikiti ta atomatik ga masu gudanarwa waɗanda matsayinsu ke "Ba Ya Aiki" ko "A Hutu". Irin waɗannan tikiti suna jira a rukunin gama-gari tare da gunkin gajimare mai ruwan gwal ko kuma ana tura su ga masu gudanarwa da ke bakin aiki.
admin_guide.card7_title: 7. Lokacin Amsa na SLA & Manufar Ƙarewar Lokaci
admin_guide.card7_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Menu mai ɗigo 3 > teburin "Saitunan Ƙungiya".
• Ƙa'idoji: Iyakar lokacin amsar farko da iyakar lokacin warware tikiti (awanni/minti).
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Ƙididdigar lokaci tana farawa a katin tikiti. Idan aka wuce iyakar, tsarin yana faɗakar da mai gudanarwa; domin hana tikiti zama ba tare da amsa ba, ana mayar da buƙatar ta atomatik zuwa rukunin tikiti na gama-gari ko kuma a sake sanya ta ga wani ƙwararren da ke akwai.
admin_guide.card8_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Menu mai ɗigo 3 > "Teburin Tsara Aiki".
• Ƙa'idoji: Masu Gudanarwa, Sassa, Manhajoji, da Rukunoni (ginshiƙai 4 na tsari).
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Babban Mai Gudanarwa yana tsara waɗanne masu gudanarwa za su duba waɗanne sassa (Saha, IT, Kuɗi) da manhajoji (Portal, Mobil). Ana ba da izini ta atomatik ta hanyar maɓallin Ed25519.
admin_guide.card9_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Menu mai ɗigo 3 > "Lissafin Amincewa".
• Ƙa'idoji: Buƙatun ƙarin matsayi zuwa Babban Mai Gudanarwa da aikin goge bayanai.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Ayyuka masu haɗari sosai ba sa aiki nan take; suna buƙatar amincewa biyu daga TheWhite Founder ko wani Babban Mai Gudanarwa daban domin tabbatar da tsaro.
admin_guide.card10_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Gunkin na'urar tebur a saman allon tikiti.
• Ƙa'idoji: Izinin haɗin P2P E2EE kai-tsaye.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Lokacin da mai amfani ya amince, ƙwararren tallafi zai iya ganin allon na'urar mai amfani kai-tsaye domin gyara matsala. Ana ɓoye wuraren kalmar sirri ta atomatik.
admin_guide.card11_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Gunkin waya da gunkin makirufo a allon tikiti.
• Ƙa'idoji: Kiran murya na WebRTC da saƙon sauti na PTT na daƙiƙa 15.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Sadarwar murya tana gudana ne ta hanyar rufaffen sirri. Saƙonnin PTT suna gogewa dindindin da zarar an saurara.
admin_guide.card12_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Babban menu > "Watsa Rediyo".
• Ƙa'idoji: Watsa sauti na kai-tsaye ga dukkan masu gudanarwa na ƙungiya.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Yana ba da damar isar da saƙon gaggawa na murya ga dukkan ma'aikata a lokaci guda ta tashar rediyo amintacciya.
admin_guide.card13_title: 13. Girbin Bayanai na Ƙasa (Federal Data Harvest - FDH)
admin_guide.card13_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Menu mai ɗigo 3 > "Girbin Bayanai (FDH)".
• Ƙa'idoji: Zaɓin mai gudanarwa, iyakar mai amfani, fitar da rumbun adana bayanai na gida.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Domin adana ikon mallakar bayanan kamfani ba tare da dogaro ga sabar waje ba, ana tattara dukkan tikiti, saƙonnin sirri, da fayiloli zuwa rumbun adana bayanai na gida da taɓawa ɗaya. Ko ba tare da intanet ba, za a iya duba tarihin duka.
admin_guide.card14_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Menu mai ɗigo 3 > "Lasisi & Biyan Kuɗi" (Babban Mai Gudanarwa kaɗai ke iya gani; a ɓoye yake ga sauran masu amfani).
• Ƙa'idoji:
  - Tsarin Core: Rufaffen sirri na AES-256 a na'urar gida, rufaffen sirri daga ƙarshe-zuwa-ƙarshe, babu bayanai a sabar, girbin bayanan gwamnati (FDH), ɓoye bayanan sirri ta atomatik, kariyar shaidar ɓoye, haɗa binciken tsari da kuskure, layin amincewa biyu, manhajojin hannu da na tebur, masu gudanarwa da masu amfani marasa iyaka, sarrafa rukunoni da ƙungiya, haɗa fayiloli da hotunan allo, babban bincike da rahoto.
  - Tsarin Live: Dukkan fasalolin Core tare da na'urar tebur ta nesa, kiran murya a cikin tikiti, danna-ka-yi-magana a cikin tikiti, da watsa shirye-shiryen rediyo.
  - Lokacin Biyan Kuɗi: Zaɓin biyan kuɗi na kowane wata ko na shekara (rangwamen 20%).
admin_guide.card15_title: 15. Farfaɗowa Bayan Bala'i & Hijirar Kayan Aikin Na'ura
admin_guide.card15_body:
• Inda za a Daidaita: Ta hanyar umarnin "wdrun admin transfer" a na'urar sarrafa mai ba da lasisi.
• Ƙa'idoji: Sunan kamfani da ke akwai da shaidar maɓallin fili na sabuwar na'ura.
• Yadda Yake Aiki: Idan na'ura ta ɓace, ta lalace, ko an canza sabuwar waya, ana miƙa maɓallin fili na sabuwar na'urar ga mai ba da lasisi. Ta wannan canjin, dukkan tarihin tikiti, sassa, saituna, da gatan mai gudanarwa ana dawo da su zuwa sabuwar na'urar ba tare da asarar kowane bayani ba.

user_guide.title: Jagoran Mai Amfani na WhiteDesk
user_guide.subtitle: Sifilin-Ilimi (Zero-Knowledge), Tsaron Bayanai & Teburin Taimako Mai Rufaffen Sirri
user_guide.card1_body: WhiteDesk ba ya taɓa tambaya ko adana lambar wayarku, adireshin imel, ko cikakkun bayanan shaidarku ta gaskiya. Lokacin da aka fara buɗe manhajar, ana samar da maɓallan tsaro na sirri guda 12 a cikin amintaccen ɓangaren kayan aikin na'urarku. Shaidarku a cikin tsarin tana da kariya ta hanyar shaidar ɓoye ta sirri wadda na'urarku kaɗai za ta iya warwarewa. Kuna iya saita da sabunta laƙabinku a kowane lokaci daga menu mai ɗigo uku a saman dama.
user_guide.card2_title: 2. Haɗawa da Ƙungiya & Buɗe Teburin Taimako
user_guide.card2_body: Rubuta lambar maɓallin fili na kamfani da ƙungiyar da ke yi muku aiki ta bayar a akwatin saƙon tikiti sannan ku tura shi. Na'urarku tana haɗawa nan take kuma cikin aminci da teburin tallafi na wannan ƙungiyar, tana loda tambarinta, sassan da aka ba izini, da ma'aikatu a kan allonku.
user_guide.card3_title: 3. Ƙirƙirar Tikitin Tallafi & Tsarin Aiki na Mataki-da-Mataki
user_guide.card3_body:
Taɓa maɓallin "Ƙirƙiri sabon tikiti" a kan babban allo domin gabatar da sabuwar buƙata:

• Dokar Shigar da Suna: Idan an kunna shigar da suna a saitunan ƙungiyar, kuna iya shigar da sunanku. Idan ƙungiyar ta kashe shi, sunanku zai kasance a ɓoye kuma za a sarrafa tikitinku a ɓoye ba tare da an san ku ba.
• Zaɓin Sashe & Rukuni: Zaɓi sashe ko ma'aikatar da ta dace da matsalarku (Kayan aiki, Hanyar sadarwa, Manhaja, da sauransu). Zaɓi daidai yana tura buƙatarku kai-tsaye ga ƙwararren da ya dace.
• Jigo & Bayani: Rubuta taƙaitaccen jigo mai ma'ana sannan cikakken bayanin matsalarku.
• Wuraren Bayani na Musamman na Kamfani: Cika kowane wuri na musamman na ƙungiya kamar lambar serial na na'ura ko lambar reshe idan an buƙata.
• Matsayin Tikiti: Tikitinku yana wucewa ta Buɗe (ƙwararre yana dubawa), An Amsa (ƙwararre ya ba da amsa), An Warware (yana jiran tabbatarwarku), da kuma An Rufe (an adana a tarihi).
user_guide.card4_title: 4. Aiki Ba Tare da Intanet Ba & Isarwa ta Atomatik
user_guide.card4_body: Kuna iya ƙirƙirar tikiti da rubuta saƙonni ko da ba tare da haɗin intanet ba. Duk abin da kuka rubuta yana adana ne a ma'ajiyar na'urarku ta gida mai aminci. Da zaran an sake samun haɗin intanet, bayanan ku za su rufe kansu da sirri a bango kuma a isar da su lami lafiya zuwa teburin da ya dace.
user_guide.card5_body: Ta amfani da gunkin maƙala a cikin tikiti, kuna iya ɗaukar hoto kai-tsaye da kyamararku, zaɓar hoton allon matsalar daga ɗakin hotunanku, ko haɗa takardu. Taɓa hotunan da aka haɗa domin faɗaɗa su a cikakken allo da duba dalla-dalla. Dukkan fayilolin da aka haɗa ana rufe su da sirri kafin su bar na'urarku.
user_guide.card6_title: 6. Ɓoye Mahimman Bayanan Sirri ta Atomatik a Na'ura
user_guide.card6_body: Lambobin katin kuɗi, lambobin shaidar ƙasa, bayanan asusun banki (IBAN), ko kalmomin sirri da aka rubuta a cikin akwatin saƙo matatun tsaro na gida suna gano su kafin su bar na'urarku. Ba a taɓa tura mahimman bayanai zuwa sabar a fili ba; ana maye gurbinsu ta atomatik da taurari (*) a na'urarku domin kare sirrinku.
user_guide.card7_title: 7. Kiran Murya & Danna-ka-yi-magana a Cikin Tikiti
user_guide.card7_body:
Kuna iya amfani da hanyoyin sadarwar murya na kai-tsaye guda biyu yayin zaman tallafi:

• Kiran Murya na Kai-tsaye Mai Rufaffen Sirri: Taɓa gunkin waya a saman dama na allon tikiti domin fara kiran murya kai-tsaye tare da ƙwararren. Da zaran an karɓa, ana kafa layin sauti mai rufaffen sirri tsakanin na'urorin biyu kai-tsaye.
• Danna-ka-yi-magana (PTT): Latsa ka riƙe gunkin makirufo a saman mashaya domin ɗaukar sauti har na daƙiƙa 15 sannan a tura shi. Da zaran ka ɗaga yatsanka, ana rufe sautin da sirri kuma a tura shi ga ƙwararren. Zame yatsanka waje domin soke kiran kafin ka saki.
• Rushe Sautin Ba Tare da Alama Ba: Sautin da aka tura na danna-ka-yi-magana ba a taɓa adana shi a kowace sabar ba. Da zaran an gama sauraro, ana goge faifan sautin dindindin daga ƙwaƙwalwar na'ura da faifan ajiya.
user_guide.card8_body: Babu buƙatar wata manhajar waje ta shiga na'ura daga nesa domin warware matsalar fasaha. Bayan amincewar juna, ƙwararren zai iya kafa zaman na'urar tebur na kai-tsaye zuwa na'urarku kuma ya yi gyare-gyaren fasaha kai-tsaye. Wuraren kalmar sirri da bayanan sirri ana baƙanta su ta atomatik a allon ƙwararren.
user_guide.card9_body: Yayin ƙirƙirar tikiti, kuna iya kunna "Haɗa Binciken Na'ura na Tsari" da kanku. Idan an kunna shi, lambobin matsayin fasaha na ayyukan kwanan nan a na'urarku za a rufe su da sirri a haɗa su ga tikitinku domin ƙwararren ya iya gano matsalarku cikin sauri sosai. Kuna iya kashe wannan maɓallin a kowane lokaci domin rashin aika kowane bayanin bincike.
user_guide.card10_title: 10. Rasitin Sirri da Ba Za a Iya Canzawa Ba & Rushe Kai
user_guide.card10_body: Ana samar da rasitin sirri mai sa hannun dijital ga kowane tikitin tallafi da aka rufe, yana tabbatar da cewa buƙatar da dukkan saƙonni ba za a taɓa iya sauya su a baya ba. Bugu da ƙari, da zaran lokacin adana bayanan ƙungiyar ya ƙare, ana lalata maɓallan sirrin tikitin dindindin daga na'urar, wanda hakan zai sa saƙonnin da suka gabata su zama marasa karantawa.
user_guide.card11_title: 11. Bincike na Kai-tsaye & Tace Bayanai Cikin Sauri
user_guide.card11_body: Rubuta lambar tikiti, jigo, ko kalma a mashayar bincike a kan babban allo domin tace jerin abubuwan da kuke nema nan take yayin da kuke rubutawa. Taɓa maɓallin sharewa (X) a hannun dama na akwatin bincike domin sake saita matatar, ko amfani da maɓallan matsayi na ƙasa (Duka, Buɗe, An Amsa, An Warware, An Rufe) domin tace buƙatunku da taɓawa ɗaya.
user_guide.card12_title: 12. Ƙimar Sabis & Na'urar Duba Lambar QR
user_guide.card12_body: Da zaran an warware buƙatarku, kuna iya ba da ƙimar tallafin da kuka samu daga tauraro 1 zuwa 5 sannan ku raba ra'ayoyinku. Kuna iya amfani da gunkin lambar QR a babban allo domin duba na'ura, kaya, ko lambobin QR na tikiti a cikin daƙiƙoƙi kaɗan tare da kyamararku.

security_privacy.title: Manufar Sirri & Tsaro
security_privacy.subtitle: Fasahar Sifilin-Ilimi & Bayyana Sirri a Fili
security_privacy.card1_body: WhiteDesk ba ya taɓa buƙatar lambar waya, ainihin suna, adireshin imel, ko shiga jerin lambobin sadarwa. Ana gudanar da zama ta hanyar shaidar sirri da ba a sani ba (WhiteID da Blind ID) waɗanda aka samar da amintaccen kayan aiki a na'urar mai amfani. Ta hanyar fasahar ginin tsarin, gano mai amfani a zahirin duniya abu ne da ba zai taɓa yiwuwa ba.
security_privacy.card2_body: Dukkan tikitin tallafi, saƙonni, da maƙalan fayiloli (kyamara, hotuna, PDFs) ana rufe su da sirri a na'urar mai amfani ta amfani da ƙa'idojin AES-256-GCM da Curve25519 kafin a tura su. Sabarori da rumbun adana bayanai kawai suna isar da ɓangarorin rubutun sirri marasa karantawa; ko masu kula da sabar ba za su taɓa iya ganin abin da ke cikin saƙon ba.
security_privacy.card3_body: Kiran murya yana gudana ne a rufe da sirri daga ƙarshe-zuwa-ƙarshe kai-tsaye a kan ramin WebRTC P2P. Sautin Danna-ka-yi-magana (PTT) ana hatimce shi ne kawai da maɓallin tikiti kuma ana goge shi dindindin daga RAM da ma'ajiyar na'ura nan take bayan an gama sauraro a na'urar da ta karɓa.
security_privacy.card4_body: Maɓallan zama na asymmetric na tikitin da aka warware kuma aka rufe ana goge su dindindin (CryptoKey.destroy) daga ma'ajiyar kayan aiki amintacciya ta na'urorin da zaran lokacin adanawa da aka saita (awanni 24, awanni 72, ko kwanaki 7) ya ƙare. Bayanan da lokacinsu ya ƙare suna komawa sautin kura da ba a iya fassarawa.
security_privacy.card5_body: Domin tikitin da aka rufe, ana ƙididdige Merkle Root Digest daga jerin lokutan dukkan lambobin hash na saƙonni. Tare da hatimin sa hannun dijital na ɓangarorin, Rasitin Rashin Sauyawa na .json yana aiki a matsayin amintacciyar shaida wadda ko mai ba da sabis ko mai amfani ba zai iya canza ta da kansa ba.
